messages:
maya: Heads up — noticed a spike in 403s after the key rotation window. embeddings API started rejecting requests that used to work. Anyone else seeing this?
raj: Can you paste a trace id or sample request?
maya: trace=abc123. Header was: Authorization: Bearer <redacted>. Token metadata we pulled shows only 'chat:read' in scopes after rotation. Rotation job ran at 06:17 UTC.
ellie: KMS rotation job reports success for keyset K-42. I also see a migration task ran around the same time to convert token metadata to per-route schemas.
oncall_sre: We pushed per-route policy changes last week; if the migration and rotation overlap we could end up with inconsistent metadata read by the auth path. Any cache TTL issues?
maya: Cache TTL is 60s but we saw a couple cache evictions during the rotation job.
raj: Reproduced locally: rotation handler writes a field named 'scopes' into KMS-wrapped metadata, but the token issuance / auth path reads 'scope_map' from the token DB. Looks like a rename slipped into the rotation branch. Old tokens still use 'scope_map'. New rotation wrote 'scopes' only -> auth fallback gives chat-only.
ellie: That explains missing embeddings. Migration used new field name, issuance path hasn't been updated. Fix: rotation should write both keys for backward compatibility.
maya: Can audits surface affected tenants so we can notify?
audits_bot: automated: 14 failed embedding requests (403) for org-314 between 06:20 and 06:30 UTC. sample_request_ids=[r-77a, r-77b, r-77c].
oncall_sre: Mitigation options: rollback to pre-rotation keys for K-42 (slow) or hotfix rotation job to write both 'scopes' and 'scope_map' and re-run for in-flight tokens. Which is lower risk?
raj: Hotfix to write both keys is minimal blast radius. I'll open a PR and add an integration test to assert both fields are present and that auth path reads either. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/rotations/pulls/482 (WIP).
maya: +1. Also add an alert: spike in per-route scope enforcement failures (rate > 5/min) and a per-tenant breakdown so we catch this earlier.
ellie: I'll run a backfill for org-314 to populate 'scope_map' from 'scopes' for affected tokens, then re-run a small batch to validate.
kms-bot: deploy: rotation-hotfix deployed to staging at 07:12 UTC.
raj: Patch merged to main. Added compatibility writes, unit+integration tests, and a migration checklist entry.
maya: Thanks. Owner for follow-up/postmortem: @raj. Action items: 1) backfill org-314 tokens (ellie) 2) add alerting (maya) 3) add rotation schema test to CI (raj).
ellie: Doing the backfill now, will report counts.
audits_bot: automated: audit-log entries retained for the failed requests; exporting CSV to security-runbook/rotation-1965432100.csv
maya: Good catch everyone. Root cause summary: schema mismatch in rotation -> missing backward-compatible scope field -> per-route auth fell back to chat-only. Prevent recurrence: compatibility writes + CI + per-route enforcement metrics. :thumbsup:
